facts.fact: The World Bank's Additional Financing for the Social Protection and Economic Resilience Project (US$154.4m, estimated board date 28 May 2026) funds the legal and technical establishment of Mozambique's National Social Registry and its interoperability with civil registration, health and education data systems.
The same financing pays to modernise the core INAS management information system (eINAS) for interoperability with other government platforms; the date given is the document's own, 19 May 2026.

systems.owner: Ministry of Labor, Gender and Social Protection (DNPC, DNAS)
